coding_context.reported_success_quote:
We confirm that spontaneous post-extinction vmPFC reactivations predict
extinction memory retrieval. This predictive effect, however, was only
observed 90 min after extinction, and was not statistically significant at 45 min
as in the discovery study. In contrast to our previous study, we find no evi dence that L-DOPA administration significantly enhances retrieval and that this is mediated by enhancement of the number of vmPFC reactivations.
